verdict.rationale: Canonical's own pages state directly that each Ubuntu release delivers the latest applications, libraries, and toolchains, and that Ubuntu is a primary platform for all major IDEs and AI/ML software. First-party docs on installing and building NVIDIA drivers back up the AI/ML GPU angle. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: named IDEs or toolchain versions, documented AI/ML stack support (e.g., CUDA/frameworks), independent or hands-on corroboration from developers.
